 Follow Us On: News SCIENCE Late-night rain, hailstorm bring dip in Delhi-NCR temperatures Late-night rain, hailstorm bring dip in Delhi-NCR temperatures
 Rain, thunderstorms and strong winds swept Delhi-NCR, with hail reported in Delhi and Noida. The spell lowered temperatures and raised hopes of improved air quality amid wider weather alerts.
 Advertisement Rain lashes out in several parts of Delhi-NCR. An early morning visual from Delhi's Jamia Milia University (Photo:PTI) By: India Today News Desk New Delhi , Oct 25, 2026 08:08 IST Last Updated Oct 25, 2026 08:08 IST Published by Nitish Singh Oct 25, 2026 03:20 IST Edited by Nitish K Singh Rain accompanied by thunder and strong winds swept across parts of Delhi-NCR late Saturday night, bringing a sudden shift in weather conditions and a noticeable dip in temperatures. Showers were reported in Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad, while hail was also reported in parts of Delhi and Noida.
 The change brought cooler winds across the region after a spell of relatively warmer conditions, with the possibility of further showers adding to the uncertainty over the weather in the hours ahead. Haryana also witnessed a spell of unsettled weather, with Hisar reporting rain and hail.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story The showers came amid a broader shift in weather conditions across northern and central India, where thunderstorms, rain and gusty winds were expected in several areas. The India Meteorological Department had issued alerts for thunderstorms and rainfall across multiple states, raising the possibility of further changes in local weather conditions.
 The sudden spell of rain brought cooler conditions across the national capital and neighbouring areas, with gusty winds and thunderstorms marking a change in the weather. The showers also raised hopes of an improvement in Delhi’s air quality, which had remained in the poor category in recent days. The city’s Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 191 on Saturday, improving from 230 a day earlier.
 The rain in Delhi-NCR comes amid a wider spell of unsettled weather expected across parts of the country. Several regions in northern, central and southern India could see rain, thunderstorms and strong winds over the coming days, with the intensity of rainfall varying from scattered showers to heavier spells. - Ends Advertisement Also Watch
